final: SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(b.spent), AVG(b.remaining), AVG(b.remaining) - overall.avg_remaining FROM budget AS b CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget) AS overall WHERE overall.avg_remaining IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event ORDER BY (AVG(b.remaining) - overall.avg_remaining) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
